items.html: And now we will explain the matter of Adam HaRishon — how he spread through these worlds. Behold, I have already informed you, in the discourse of Tanna DeBei Eliyahu — "the world endures six thousand years" — in Parashat Beresheet, regarding the sin of Adam HaRishon, that Adam HaRishon comprised three worlds, namely Beria, Yetzira, and Assiya. And see there well, at length.
